name: Paladin
body:
Alignment: Any non-chaotic non-evil

Mentorship Ability

Apprentices who study a mentor’s paladin class levels gains the paladin‘s smite evil class feature. When determining the damage and uses per day of the apprentice’s smite, the apprentice’s effective paladin level is equal to half his apprentice level (minimum 1). The apprentice uses his own Charisma bonus when determining the bonuses to attacks and deflection bonus to AC against the target of their smite. The apprentice must uphold that their mentor’s paladin code. If he does not, the apprentice loses all benefits of his paladin mentorship.

Advanced Mentorship Ability

Apprentices who study a mentor’s paladin class levels and chooses paladin for their advanced mentorship ability for the day gains the paladin‘s lay on hands class feature. When determining the healing and number of uses per day of the apprentice’s lay on hands, the apprentice’s effective paladin level is equal to his apprentice level minus 3. At 10th level and every three levels thereafter, the apprentice can select a mercy their mentor possesses to add to their lay on hands. Apprentices cannot select a mercy that requires 6th level as their first mercy. Apprentices cannot select a mercy that requires 9th level as their first or second mercy. Apprentices cannot select a mercy that requires 12th level as their first, second, or third mercy.

Cooperation Power

Key ability: Charisma

Apprentices who study a mentor’s paladin class levels and chooses paladin for their cooperation power may spend a cooperation point as an immediate action before he or an adjacent ally attempts a saving throw, to add his Charisma modifier to the result of the save. He must choose to do this before the roll is made.

FAQ

What if the mentor is an Antipaladin?

Antipaladin mentors work much in the same way paladin mentors do. To study with an antipaladin mentor, the apprentice must be of a non-lawful, non-good alignment. Instead of gaining the paladin‘s smite evil class feature, they gain the antipaladin‘s smite good class feature. Instead of gaining the paladin‘s lay on hands class feature, they gain the antipaladin‘s touch of corruption class feature and may select cruelties instead of mercies to modify them.
